---
name: Skill proposal
about: Propose a new skill or a substantial extension of an existing one
title: "proposal: <skill-name>"
labels: enhancement
---

**Capability**
What should an agent be able to do with this skill that it cannot do cleanly
today?

**Shape**
New skill directory, or extension of an existing skill? If new, the proposed
`skills/<name>/`.

**Authority boundary**
What decisions does the procedure explicitly NOT make? (Every skill here is
procedural only; authority stays with roles and the operator.)

**Overlap check**
Which existing skills come closest (see `SKILLS-INDEX.md`), and why don't they
cover this?
